id.description: Unique identifier for the conditional result (unique to the parent action)

thisStep.description: The status to set this state to. Default is 'complete' if not defined. Cannot be 'active'.

activateSteps.description: Optional array of step IDs to transition to an active state

skipSteps.description: Optional array of step IDs to transition to a skipped state

completeSteps.description: Optional array of step IDs to transition to a complete state

pendingSteps.description: Optional array of step IDs to transition to a pending state

skipIncompleteSteps.description: Optional array of step IDs to transition to a skipped state (if not already skipped or complete)

activateIncompleteSteps.description: Optional array of step IDs to transition to an active state (if not already skipped or complete)

appendState.description: Abitrary data to append to the flow state.

joins.description: Optional array of join IDs to execute after this result (if all join steps are complete)

preHandlers.description: Array of pre-handlers to run before steps are transitioned.

postHandlers.description: Array of pre-handlers to run before steps are transitioned.
